post.description:
Requires `enquiries:update`. Allowed transitions:

- NEW → CONTACTED, CLOSED_LOST
- ASSIGNED → CONTACTED, CLOSED_LOST
- CONTACTED → QUOTATION_SENT, NEGOTIATION, CLOSED_WON, CLOSED_LOST
- QUOTATION_SENT → NEGOTIATION, CLOSED_WON, CLOSED_LOST
- NEGOTIATION → QUOTATION_SENT, CLOSED_WON, CLOSED_LOST
- CLOSED_WON → (final)
- CLOSED_LOST → CONTACTED

NEW/ASSIGNED follow assignment.

put.description: Requires `enquiries:assign`. Assigning a NEW enquiry moves it to ASSIGNED; unassigning an ASSIGNED enquiry moves it back to NEW. Closed enquiries cannot be reassigned.
